releaseNotes: Crash fixes: the player no longer crashes when a video source is released mid-playback, low-memory devices no longer hit a fatal speech-detection crash, subtitle probing and download workers survive background teardown, promise rejections in haptics/KeepAwake/play-pause can no longer take down the app, and the player WebView is hardened against fatal uncaught exceptions. Anime back: JustAnime now queries with the correct AniList id — all four JustAnime servers were returning 404 and falling back; MAL + AniList ids are carried from search through to playback, so titles missing from the local mapping table still play. Player: fullscreen immersive mode now stays active when you switch to the next episode while in fullscreen, the progress bar no longer drops to 0% on seek or source reload, HEVC dual-decoder playback and first-frame speed are improved, VTT subtitle files convert to SRT so subtitle position applies, and answering the audio-language prompt from Settings now counts. Streaming: HTML resolver pages are treated as dead sources (fewer stuck probes), Falix moved to its new host and API, and saved servers that cannot play anime are ignored in anime mode. Downloads: speed limits, notification actions, offline playback, title-based file names, metadata badges, TV episode grouping, and fail-fast behavior on dead links or full storage.
